AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation Measures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation Measures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation Measures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation Measures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation Measures.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Pest and Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Pest and Disease Control.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen and Backyard Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Poultry Rearing in a Fold? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain ICT Support Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Soil Conservation Measures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Water Harvesting and Storage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kitchen and Backyard Gardening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
